data.narrative:
ClearSpace is a Series A+ stage company in Space & Aerospace founded by Luc Piguet and Muriel Richard. The sector comprises 5 public comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including SpaceX, Rocket Lab, ICEYE, Sierra Space, and Planet Labs, though the company operates in a fragmented subsector with limited direct peers at matching stage and scale.

Conventional valuation triangulation methods yield limited results. Peer-median anchoring is inapplicable due to absence of three or more same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables within the narrow Space & Aerospace peer set—the 14 total same-sector companies do not cluster sufficiently at ClearSpace's development stage. Public-comparable anchoring using the sector's 27.4x P/S median across six listed tickers cannot be applied without disclosed target revenue, which private companies typically withhold.

The analysis cannot produce a definitive triangulated valuation range given current data constraints. Key uncertainties include ClearSpace's revenue (if any) and the appropriate peer discount for an unlisted Series A+ company relative to public Space & Aerospace names. Forward progress on valuation would require either disclosure of ClearSpace's revenue and near-term unit economics, identification of additional late-stage private Space & Aerospace comparables at similar fundraising scale, or clarity on the company's specific subsector focus to refine the relevant peer universe.
